functions.name: generate_vision_doc
functions.title: Generate Vision Document
functions.description: Generates a comprehensive vision document defining what to build and why for a business/project. The mandatory foundation before any building begins. Call when starting a new project or when the user wants to define their business vision.

industry.description: Industry or niche (e.g. epoxy, hvac, roofing)

productDescription.description: What the product/app does (for non-marketing builds)

businessType.description: local service business, SaaS, e-commerce, etc.

functions.name: generate_strategy_doc
functions.title: Generate Strategy Document
functions.description: Generates a comprehensive strategy document (positioning, GTM, revenue, pricing, roadmap, risks) building on an approved vision. Requires an existing vision document. Call after vision is generated and approved.

functions.name: run_autonomous_build_cycle
functions.title: Run Autonomous Build Cycle
functions.description: Drives the Auto Builder pipeline — finds builds with auto-advance enabled and processes their next step. Enforces blast radius caps and governance tiers. Call to advance queued builds through their pipeline steps automatically.

functions.name: discover_business_leads
functions.title: Discover Business Leads
functions.description: Autonomous lead discovery engine — searches for businesses with bad websites or poor online presence, checks website health, calculates opportunity scores, and saves as BusinessLead records. Call to find new sales prospects in a specific industry and location.

check_websites.description: Whether to check actual website health (default true)

functions.name: send_outreach_email
functions.title: Send Outreach Email
functions.description: Sends an outreach email to a backlink prospect via the connected Gmail account. Requires a prospect_id and email body. Call to send partnership/outreach emails to prospects.

prospect_id.description: ID of the BacklinkProspect to email

functions.name: generate_api_key
functions.title: Generate API Key
functions.description: Generates a cryptographically random API key for external access to the platform. Three types: admin (full access), user (read-only), vision_cortex (full diagnostic/heal/optimize autonomy). Call to create new API keys for external integrations.

permissions.description: Custom permissions list (optional, defaults by type)

expires_at.description: ISO datetime when key expires (optional, null = never)

functions.name: run_self_optimization
functions.title: Run Self-Optimization
functions.description: Self-healing and self-optimization engine — monitors for stuck builds, failed builds, XPS catalog health, floor systems, pipeline health, and lead engine status. Auto-heals issues found. Call to run a system health check and auto-fix problems.

functions.name: run_architect_scan
functions.title: Run AI Architect Scan
functions.description: The AI Chief Architect — analyzes current system state, searches the web for emerging AI capabilities and technologies, and generates visionary proposals across 6 categories (what to build, how to build, new technology, AI capabilities, integrations, strategic direction). Call for strategic AI-driven system analysis and improvement proposals.

triggered_by.description: Source of the scan (manual, workflow, etc.)

functions.name: run_council_decision
functions.title: Run Council Decision
functions.description: Runs an 11-round multi-agent council debate across specialized intelligence archetypes (systems architect, contrarian, epistemic auditor, economist, risk engineer, etc.) to reach a well-reasoned decision on a strategic question. Dissent is preserved, confidence is scored. Call for complex strategic/architectural/investment decisions.

subject_id.description: Optional ID of the subject being decided on

functions.name: deploy_autobuild_site
functions.title: Deploy AutoBuild Site
functions.description: Takes an AutoBuild record, generates a real React app from its specs (architecture, data_model, ui_system), pushes to GitHub, deploys to Vercel, and verifies the site is live. Call to deploy a completed build to production.

autobuild_id.description: ID of the AutoBuild record to deploy

functions.name: generate_website_content
functions.title: Generate Website Content
functions.description: Generates rich, location-aware website copy (hero, about, services, FAQ) for a client's site using real web context about their area. Call to create website content for a business.

functions.name: check_domain_availability
functions.title: Check Domain Availability
functions.description: Checks real-time domain availability via RDAP for a list of domains. Returns available/registered status for each. Call to check if domain names are available for purchase.

domains.description: List of domain names to check (e.g. example.com)

functions.name: generate_invoice
functions.title: Generate Invoice
functions.description: Generates a professional invoice with realistic line items for a digital marketing/lead gen engagement. Returns line items, subtotal, tax, total, and notes. Call to create an invoice for a client.

functions.name: run_business_simulation
functions.title: Run Business Simulation
functions.description: Monte Carlo business simulation engine — runs probabilistic projections (1000 iterations) across time horizons and scenarios. Shows p10/p50/p90 outcomes, break-even, probability of success, expected value, and sensitivity analysis. Call to simulate business/decision outcomes before committing.

input_variables.description: Business input variables (customers, price, growth rate, costs, etc.)

prior_result_id.description: Optional prior result ID for comparison

functions.name: score_idea_candidate
functions.title: Score Idea Candidate
functions.description: Re-scores an individual IdeaCandidate using the AI scoring engine (YC 10-key-question framework, autonomous system classification). Call to evaluate or re-evaluate a business idea.

idea_id.description: ID of the IdeaCandidate to score

functions.name: generate_mass_websites
functions.title: Generate Mass Websites
functions.description: Bulk generates every auto-builder step (logos, content, HTML) for all sites in a MassBuildProject batch. Processes sites in parallel. Call to generate websites in bulk for a mass build project.

step.description: Optional specific step to run (default all)

functions.name: clone_and_launch
functions.title: Clone and Launch Site
functions.description: Unified clone-to-launch pipeline — scrapes a target website, analyzes it, generates rebranded content, provisions GitHub/Drive/Supabase/Vercel, generates logos and images, creates SEO campaign, identifies monetization, and validates. Call to clone a competitor site and launch a rebranded version.

target_url.description: URL of the site to clone (required if no project_id)

auto_proceed.description: Whether to auto-advance through phases (default true)

functions.name: run_rank_engine
functions.title: Run Rank Engine
functions.description: SEO rank engine — discovers keywords, generates programmatic landing pages with JSON-LD, builds citation targets, and audits SEO readiness. Supports quick_start (auto-detect from URL) or start (manual config). Call to create or run an SEO campaign for a site.
